data.narrative:
CuspAI is a Series A AI & Software company founded by Max Welling and Chad Edwards that has raised $100M+. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of nine private peers and one public reference (Palantir), spanning frontier AI infrastructure and applied AI platforms at Series A–B stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $100M raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implying $200M. Peer-median analysis across five comparable companies (Scale AI at $29.0B, Reflection AI at $25.0B, Physical Intelligence at $5.6B, Black Forest Labs at $3.2B, and Field AI at $2.0B) yields a median valuation of $5.6B, with a range spanning $2.0B to $29.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneous capital structures and product maturity within frontier AI.

The two methods produce a triangulated valuation range of $170M (low) to $6.4B (high), with a median of $2.9B. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects the outsized valuations achieved by recent AI infrastructure rounds, particularly Reflection AI and Scale AI at Series A–B stages. Key uncertainties include CuspAI's specific product differentiation, customer traction, and capital efficiency relative to the comp set, all of which would inform positioning within the $2.9B–$5.6B band.
